ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 98:2 black-to-white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation (Type 1) covers the entire visible fluke surface. Small, high-contrast white focal spots (1-5 pixel diameter) are sparsely distributed, primarily clustered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; the depth is approximately 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, mid-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels. Noted concentration of sharper peaks at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dispersed circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring; one prominent cluster in the mid-section of the right lobe and several near the leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct diagonal white linear disruption is visible on the outer edge of the left lobe. Fainter, vertical linear marks are detectable on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear scar on the distal end of the left lobe; possible minor indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe consistent with past tissue loss.
